summary.headline: Planetary Lords in the Angles
summary.text: Astrological instructions for judging a year through planetary aspects, conjunctions, eclipses, planetary light, and the twelve signs, with special emphasis on the angles. Chapter 36 begins interpretations of Mars and other planets as lords of the year in the angles, including royal violence, famine, death, disease, and winds.
